verdict.rationale: Swell documents file-based apps, serverless functions, webhooks, and a CLI that pushes configuration files to a development store. It does not document versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Keeping app files in a user's own source control would be a user-side workaround, and test/live keys and theme duplication are adjacent features, not version history or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
